description: How to authenticate to the OneSource REST API — an API key from a subscription, x402 (USDC on Base), or MPP (USDC.e or pathUSD on Tempo) — and how to choose between them. This covers calling the REST API directly; to configure this MCP server, call 1s_setup_check. Free, no authentication required.

title: Authentication Guide
